heroHeadline: Oil Crashes 8-9% on Iran Ceasefire Progress; S&P 500 ATH 7,259; ADP April +109K; RBA Hikes to 4.35% — Warsh Vote Week of May 11, BLS Jobs Report May 8
heroSubtitle: May 5-6: The Strait of Hormuz situation turned sharply on May 5-6. Iran struck a South Korean VLCC tanker on May 5, driving oil to ~$114 (Brent) and Dow -1.1%. Then on May 6, Iran submitted a revised ceasefire proposal through Pakistani mediators and Trump paused 'Project Freedom' — oil crashed 8-9% (Brent $103, WTI $93-95), S&P 500 surged to new ATH 7,259.22 (+0.81%), Nasdaq hit a record 25,326.13. US officials told Axios a '14-point MoU' to end the Iran war is close. ISM Services PMI (released May 5): headline 53.6, Prices Paid 70.7 — highest since 2022, stagflation alarm despite growth resilience. ADP April private payrolls: +109,000 (beat vs March +62K; pay growth +4.4%). RBA raised cash rate +25 bps to 4.35% (May 2026, third consecutive 2026 hike; Australia CPI 4.6%). USTR Section 301 hearings ran May 5-8 targeting 16 countries to replace Section 122 tariffs before July 23 cliff. Kevin Warsh Senate floor vote expected week of May 11 (~92% probability, Powell term expires May 15). BLS April nonfarm payrolls due May 8 (consensus ~60K). Trump-Xi Beijing summit May 14-15.
footerNote: Data sourced from IMF WEO Apr 2026, IEA Oil Market Report, EIA Today in Energy, BEA (Q1 2026 GDP Advance +2.0% + March PCE 3.5%/3.2% core, Apr 30), BLS, Federal Reserve FOMC (Apr 29 unanimous hold), ECB (Apr 30 hold 2.00%), Bank of England (Apr 30 hold 8-1, 3.75%), Reserve Bank of Australia (May 2026 hike 4.35%), BOJ (Apr 28 hold 6-3, 0.75%), ISM Services PMI April 2026 (May 5 release), ADP National Employment Report April 2026 (May 6 release), University of Michigan final Apr survey, Conference Board Apr, CBP CAPE Portal, USTR Section 301, Goldman Sachs Research (~22% recession), JPMorgan Global Markets Strategy (~28%), Moody's Analytics (~42%), Al Jazeera Hormuz/Iran coverage, CNBC, Fortune, PRNewswire, RBA media releases.
